trajectory.patch:
An issue in `subsys/net/lib/http/http_client.c` causes `body_frag_len` to be calculated from the raw `data_len` remaining in `recv_buf` after `body_frag_start` rather than accumulating the actual decoded body `length` passed to `on_body()`. When `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` is used and chunk trailers/framing follow the chunk data in the same `recv_buf`, `data_len - (body_frag_start - recv_buf)` includes the trailing chunk framing bytes, overcounting `body_frag_len`.

Accumulating `length` in `on_body()` (which is already reset before each `http_parser_execute()` call) ensures `body_frag_len` reflects the exact decoded body fragment length.

include/zephyr/net/http/client.h
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
	 * body_frag_start >= recv_buf
	 * body_frag_len = data_len - (body_frag_start - recv_buf)
	 */
========
	 * body_frag_start >= recv_buf
	 * body_frag_len <= data_len - (body_frag_start - recv_buf)
	 */
>>>>>>>> REPLACE

subsys/net/lib/http/http_client.c
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
	/* Calculate the length of the body contained in the recv_buf */
	req->internal.response.body_frag_len = req->internal.response.data_len -
		(req->internal.response.body_frag_start - req->internal.response.recv_buf);
========
	/* Calculate the length of the body contained in the recv_buf */
	req->internal.response.body_frag_len += length;
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
